instruction: An archaeological mound: a broad low rounded earth mound on a flat grid-aligned ground plane, with a couple of footpaths worn up its sides and a few slender marker posts on top. Meter scale, muted earth tones.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a archaeological mound. An archaeological mound: a broad low rounded earth mound on a flat grid-aligned ground plane, with a couple of footpaths worn up its sides and a few slender marker posts on top. Meter scale, muted earth tones. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
